gloss: selfishness; doing as one pleases; willfulness

definitions.gloss: selfishness; doing as one pleases; willfulness
definitions.explanation: Behaving according to one's own wishes without regard for others. Used both as a noun and as a na-adjective to describe selfish behavior or a self-centered personality.

examples.japanese: {我|わが}{勝手|かって}な{行動|こうどう}は{許|ゆる}されない。
{彼|かれ}はいつも{我|わが}{勝手|かって}で、{周|まわ}りの{迷惑|めいわく}を{考|かんが}えない。
examples.english: He is always selfish and doesn't think about the trouble he causes others.

examples.japanese: {我|わが}{勝手|かって}を{言|い}って{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありませんが、{予定|よてい}を{変更|へんこう}していただけませんか。
examples.english: I'm sorry for the selfish request, but would it be possible to change the schedule?

notes:
A compound of {我|わが} (one's own; my) and {勝手|かって} (one's own convenience; selfishness). Functions as both a noun ({我|わが}{勝手|かって}を{言|い}う) and a na-adjective ({我|わが}{勝手|かって}な).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {我|わが}{勝手|かって}な{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い: selfish behavior
- {我|わが}{勝手|かって}を{言|い}う: to say selfish things; to make selfish demands
- {我|わが}{勝手|かって}な{人|ひと}: a selfish person
- {我|わが}{勝手|かって}な{理由|りゆう}: a self-serving reason

SIMILAR WORDS:
- わがまま: selfish; spoiled — more common in everyday speech, slightly childish nuance
- {身勝手|みがって}: selfish; self-centered — stronger negative connotation
- {自分勝手|じぶんかって}: doing things one's own way — very close synonym, more colloquial
- {自由勝手|じゆうかって}: acting freely as one pleases — less negative, implies freedom rather than selfishness
